what_it_checks: The SweepShape child law and the separate stochastic contracts' draw ordering.
derivation: For the geometric tail used by SweepShape with single probability s and continuation probability c, P(N=1)=s, P(N=2)=(1-s)c, P(N=3)=(1-s)c^2 and P(N=4)=(1-s)c^3. The values below use s=1/2 and c=1/2, giving 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16. Section 7 places this draw after price/book work on contract A, and inside next_parent after budget and latent updates on contract B.
